exact_quote.text: Students should receive a graduation code from only one school.

findings.paraphrase: The diploma-issuing school reports G, W7, or S7. Concurrent schools should record W1 before that graduation code. The example contrasts a diploma school with another school providing CTE courses.
The timeline schedules validation of fiscal-year 2024 graduate data from May 25 through July 1, 2025.
Schools are advised to review both current and prior-year graduate records, using prior-year correction processes when needed.

interpretation: Supports a one-graduation-code administrative compliance scenario relevant to FY2024 graduate validation. It does not establish that archived school aggregates are error-free, that all cohort denominators are disjoint, or that later school geography matches the graduation cohort.

supporting_source.paraphrase: Cohort membership follows the student; students remain assigned to the last high school of record. The school recording the graduation exit is the last school. The retrieved paragraph omits the dual-G exception present in the older indexed manuals, but full-document absence has not been verified.
